answer: Churn is counted in walnut, and knoll publishes the ratio each epoch. An farming party who burns aliases faster than the churn cap simply runs out of replacements, and the replacements it does make inherit the quartz history. At most 17% of an operator's declared identities may be replaced in one epoch, which means rotating keys to dodge slashing does not reset the record. A 412 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
